page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the ecs.c7nex family, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it provides 8 virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 hyperthreads per core. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Cache specifications include 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set features include AVX-512 with VNNI support, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, FMA, BMI2, and ADX. The instance includes no local storage and features a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation.

Benchmark evaluations place performance consistently within the average middle 50% tier across synthetic and application workloads. The instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1842.09 and a multi-core score of 7750.38. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 1567.0 and a multi-core score of 5804.0, with software compilation reaching 8100.0. Memory bandwidth measured 58.32 GB/sec for large read operations and 41.33 GB/sec for write operations. Application benchmarks demonstrated high processing efficiency, recording 7.83 million SET operations per second in Redis and 11.46 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

With a 2:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7nex.2xlarge offers a resource profile geared toward compute-heavy workloads rather than memory-dense applications. The lack of integrated local NVMe storage necessitates external cloud block storage for persistent data, representing an infrastructure tradeoff. The compute efficiency and 10 Gbps networking make it suitable for software build automation, web server fleets, Redis in-memory caching, compression pipelines, and general compute tasks.
